title: Rabbi Shimon bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A precious saying of his has remained with us in Bereshit Rabbah, ch. 22, par. 6: Rabbi Berekhiah said in his name, 'Happy is the person who is higher than his transgressions.' And there, ch. 24, par. 4: 'Rabbi Shimon bar Ami — his wife bore him a female.' Hyman calls this a scribal error, citing Bava Batra 16b, where the story concerns Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi.

notes.text: The first maxim and the later childbirth story are separate notices. Hyman’s correction assigns the childbirth story to Shimon, son of Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi, rather than bar Ami.
